mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Federal Funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE spike and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between GDPC1 drop and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a strong supply-side recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO surge and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strong consumer demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a tight labor market and strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not significantly predict positive SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not significantly predict negative SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer spending and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 1% MoM and UNRATE drops
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not significantly predict positive SPX returns (p > 0.05).
